annotations.annotation_text: Title of the climactic final section of the novel, chronicling the coordinated physical and cybernetic assault on Villa Straylight to breach the Turing locks and unite the twin AIs.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 171.

annotations.target_phrase: Your name is Henry Dorsett Case.
annotations.annotation_text: The Turing Police agent interrogating Case, reciting his official civil registry and BAMA identity number, demonstrating the extensive administrative apparatus designed to police AI sentience.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 171.
